purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.

registryAssessment: The Enugu State Government’s ENGIS identifies itself as the state digital land-administration platform and lists a Nsukka zonal land center. Its Surveyor General’s public maps page describes mapped parcel/property boundaries and official land records. This confirms a Nsukka-linked state land-service center, but not WUP-point coverage.

searchQueries.query: Nsukka official land registry cadastral parcel GIS map Enugu State ENGIS
searchQueries.result: English and Igbo-oriented local-language searches surfaced the official Enugu State ENGIS platform and its Nsukka zonal land center. The Surveyor General map page advertises public map viewing, but it also supports survey-number and owner/address/parcel searches. The Launch Map Viewer link redirects to an account login. No login, search term, or parcel identifier was supplied; no field schema or geometry was queried.
